MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 9
   C. 3
   D. 6

2. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

3. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 5

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

11. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
